text: The busiest traders earned the least.
Checking your stocks every hour? Careful.
Researchers followed sixty-six thousand households at one broker, for six years.
Then they sorted them by how much they traded.
The busiest fifth flipped their whole portfolio more than twice a year.
Before fees, everyone earned about the same.
But after fees? The busiest traders made eleven point four percent a year.
The quietest ones? Eighteen point five.
Every trade costs a little. So more trades cost a lot.
So who's busier with their money... you, or your wealth?
